gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Fun and organic, with a stroke rhythm kept firmly in check. Irish Grover supplies sturdy, oversized-looking words, while Noto Sans Gujarati meets them with large open counters and curved strokes.

gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Irish Grover steps softly from heavy to light strokes. Noto Sans Kannada keeps paragraphs moving, its s curves open wide at both ends and its capitals only a gentle bump up.
